# Boiler

serviced annually since 2024.

## Identifiers

- Model: Calderon Optima 832
- Serial: 21094500100327845901
- Gas registration number of the installer: 578812
- Warranty expired: June 2029

## Service history

- April 2026 — annual service, expansion vessel recharged
- April 2025 — annual service, condensate trap cleared
- May 2024 — annual service, diverter valve replaced under warranty
